ORDER
______________________________________
WHEREAS
(1) An Application was filed on 4th September, 2012 by Lorna Fraser (the “Application”) for portions of
lands comprised in Sea Cows Bay Registration Section, Block 2635B, Parcels 1, 5, 7, 12, 19, 20, 32
and 163 be partitioned and subdivided in accordance with survey Plan CA-2635B-088T drawn by
J.A.E. Morshead and dated 22nd April, 2004, such that:
 Parcel 12 and Lots 5, 6, 7 and 9 of Parcel 19 be registered to Lorna Fraser on behalf of the
family of James Adolph Christopher in full satisfaction of his entitlement ; and
 The name of Lorna Fraser on behalf of James Adolph Christopher be removed from the title
in respect of Parcels 1, 5, 7, 20, 32 and 163.
(2) Notice of the Application was published in:

3RD DECEMBER, 2015 VIRGIN ISLANDS OFFICIAL GAZETTE Vol. XLIX, No. 91 4020
 The Standpoint Newspaper of Thursday, March 14, 2013
 The BVI Beacon Newspaper of Thursday, March 28, 2013, and
 The Island Sun Newspaper of Saturday, 30th March 2013, and
 The Virgin Islands Gazette Volume XLVII No (of 4th April 2013), No. 21 (of 11th April,
2013) and No 24 (of 18th April 2013)
(3) A Hearing was convened by the Chief Registrar of Lands on 14th November, 2013 which Hearing was
adjourned to 20th November, 2013
(4) At the Hearing convened on 20th November, 2013, the Chief Registrar of Lands issued an Order (the
“Order”) which was not limited to:
“1. Dr. McKelly and/or Mr. Albato King to file and serve within 30 days from today. After reviewing
the application in its entirety including the relevant survey plans CA-2635B-088-T and CA-2635-113-
T. A schematic complete with roads of how they propose the entire family estate comprising Parcels 1,
5, 7, 12, 19, 20, 32 and 163 can be divided in 9 shares and further to how the 1/9th share further
divided pursuant to Inst#2294/2006 can be in accordance with that scheme.
2. The applicant to file and serve a response within 14 days
3. Further directions to be given by the Chief Registrar with a view to concluding the matter within
30 days.”
(5) By letter dated 29th September, 2015 delivered to an agent of Dr. Bernadette McKelly a letter
addressed to Mr. Albato King the Registrar of Lands directed that the schematic be produced within
thirty days from the 29th September, 2015, in accordance with the Order. The said letter required that
failure to produce the said schematic will result in the issuance of a further order that the Estate be
partitioned in the following manner:
“(a) To take out Lot 1 – Lot 9 of Parcel 5 using Survey Plan No CA-2635B-113-T, the entire Parcel 12,
and Lots 5-9 of Parcel 19 using Survey Plan No CA-2635B-088-T, all in full satisfaction of the
family of Blanche Agatha Norman and James Adolph Christopher’s entitlement to the lands in
Parcel 1, 5, 7, 12, 20, 32 and 163; and
(b) Thereafter, the name of Lorna Fraser as Trustee” be removed from Parcels 1, 7, 20, 32, 163 and
the remnant of parcels 5 and 19.”
(6) As of the date hereof Mr. Albato King, Dr. Bernadette McKelly, their individual or collective servants
or agents have failed to comply with the directive set out in the Order or in Registrar’s letter of 29th
September, 2015
NOW THEREFORE is HEREBY ORDERED that:
1. The application by Lorna Fraser to:
(a) To take out Lot 1 – Lot 9 of Parcel 5 using Survey Plan No CA-2635B-113-T, the entire Parcel 12,
and Lots 5-9 of Parcel 19 using Survey Plan No CA-2635B-088-T, all in full satisfaction of the
family of Blanche Agatha Norman and James Adolph Christopher’s entitlement to the lands in
Parcel 1, 5, 7, 12, 20, 32 and 163; and
(b) TO HAVE , the name of “Lorna Fraser as Trustee” be removed from Parcels 1, 7, 20, 32, 163 and
the remnant of parcels 5 and 19

3RD DECEMBER, 2015 VIRGIN ISLANDS OFFICIAL GAZETTE Vol. XLIX, No. 91 4021

NOTICE REQUIRING PERSONS TO REGISTER AS
VOTERS IN ACCORDANCE WITH SECTION 4(1)(C)
OF THE ELECTION ACT NO. 16 0F 1994
18613 TAKE NOTICE that in accordance with Sections 6(1) and 14 of the Elections Act any person qualified as
a voter under Section 68 of the Constitution may apply to the Supervisor of Elections for registration as a
voter.
2. A person resident in the Virgin Islands may apply in Form No. 1 of the Second Schedule to the Act.
3. A person resident in the United States Virgin Islands may apply in Form No. 7 of the Second Schedule
to the Act.
4. Application Forms Nos. 1 and 7 may be obtained at the Office of the Supervisor of Elections, as well
as the following places –
(a) The District Officer, Anegada
(b) The Post Office, North Sound, Virgin Gorda
(c) The Post Office, Valley, Virgin Gorda
(d) The Post Office, East End
(e) The Post Office, Road Town
(f) The Post Office, West End
(g) The Post Office, Carrot Bay
(h) The Post Office, Cane Garden Bay
(i) The Government Office, Jost Van Dyke
Form No. 7 is also available at the Office of Smith’s Ferry in St. Thomas.
5. The qualifications for voters are set out in Section 68 of the Virgin Islands
(Constitution) Order 2007, which is in the following terms:
Qualification of voters “68.
(1) Subject to subsection (3),
a person shall be qualified to be registered as a voter for the purposes of elections if, and
shall not be so qualified unless, he or she belongs to the Virgin Islands and on the
qualifying date has attained the age of eighteen years and he or she either -
(a) is domiciled and resident in the Virgin Islands on the qualifying date; or
(b) on that date is domiciled in the Virgin Islands and resident in the United States
Virgin Islands:
(2) Subject to subsection (3), any person who was qualified to be
registered as a voter immediately before the commencement of this
Constitution shall continue to be so qualified thereafter.
(3) No person shall be qualified to be registered as a voter under this Section who on the
qualifying date –
a. is a person certified to be insane or otherwise adjudged to be of unsound mind under
any law in force in the Virgin Islands;
b. is disqualified by or under any such law from being registered
as a voter for the purposes of elections by reason of his or her
having been convicted of an offence relating to elections; or

3RD DECEMBER, 2015 VIRGIN ISLANDS OFFICIAL GAZETTE Vol. XLIX, No. 91 4023
c. is under sentence of death imposed on him or her by a court or is serving a sentence
of imprisonment (by whatever named called) for a term exceeding twelve months
imposed on him or her by a court or substituted by competent authority for some
other sentence imposed on him or her by a court.
(4) In this Section “the qualifying date” means such date as may
be appointed by or under any law in force in the Virgin Islands as the
date with reference to which the qualifications or any person for
registration are to be ascertained.
(5) For the purposes of subsection (3)(c) –
a. two or more sentences of imprisonment that are required to be served consecutively
shall be regarded as separate sentences if none of those sentences exceeds twelve
month, but if any one
